summary: VX2780/TD2455 USB-C DP Alt Mode handshake fails on macOS 15
Eco mode auto power-off triggers during active use (firmware 1.0.7)
workaround: Update firmware to 1.0.8, or disable Eco Mode in OSD.

summary: TD2455 touch unresponsive after Windows 11 24H2 update / resume from sleep
workaround: Reinstall touch driver 3.2 and disable USB selective suspend.

summary: XG2431 OSD freezes when switching to PIP mode at 240Hz
workaround: Lower refresh to 165Hz before enabling PIP.

summary: VX3218 KVM switch does not pass keyboard after input change
workaround: Re-plug the USB upstream cable after switching input.
